config.expected_if_false: In at least 2 of 3 seeds, accel_step reaches required_margin at or before the first checkpoint with val_mse_ratio < 1 (so the ordering is the same as at N=64), or accel_step formation differs from the matched N=64 seed by more than 40 steps in at least 2 seeds.
config.expected_if_true: In at least 2 of 3 seeds (47, 48, 49), the first checkpoint with val_mse_ratio < 1 comes strictly before the first checkpoint where the accel_step margin over the best-of-5 control is >= required_margin. Each seed's accel_step formation step lies in [45, 130], within 40 steps of its N=64 counterpart (85, 90, 85).
config.hypothesis: The N=64 result that accel_step forms before the model beats constant-velocity extrapolation (f-20261012-005950-42a7, steps 85-90 vs 135-165) is specific to N=64. At N=16 the baseline is much weaker, so val_mse_ratio falls below 1 before accel_step reaches its required margin, while the accel_step formation step itself stays within 40 steps of the seed-matched N=64 runs (85-90).
